question: Across many different rule-legal approaches to the challenge and to the funded account, which reach a funded account fastest and cheapest and then keep paying?
registration_note: Declared 2026-10-03 before any v5 simulation. 15 challenge approaches x 4 funded approaches, each with one a-priori parameter set; nothing tuned. Same rule snapshot, universes, 0.8 buffer, 365-day caps, retry model and metrics as prop-firm-v4. Banned schemes excluded. Historical seen data, so descriptive; both samples must agree.

challenge_approaches.C01_blend_2x_headroom: v4 reference: blend, 2x, headroom scaling, vol guard
challenge_approaches.C02_blend_cppi: blend, scale = 4 x (equity - max-loss floor) / (annual vol of the book), capped at 4 (risk proportional to headroom, constant-proportion portfolio insurance)
challenge_approaches.C03_two_speed: blend 3x until half the target is reached, then 1x (protect the gain)
challenge_approaches.C04_catch_up: blend, scale 1x + 0.02x per elapsed day, capped at 4x, with headroom scaling (risk rises if slow)
challenge_approaches.C05_constant_vol_25: blend scaled daily to 25% annual vol (30-day trailing estimate), cap 5x, headroom scaling
challenge_approaches.C06_equity_curve_filter: blend 2x only while the book's own 20-day cumulative return is positive, else 0.5x; headroom scaling
challenge_approaches.C07_regime_trend_bull: blend 2.5x when the market regime is TREND or BULL (strategy_zoo labels), else 1x; headroom scaling
challenge_approaches.C08_momentum_leg_1x: XS momentum leg alone, 1x, headroom scaling, vol guard
challenge_approaches.C09_trend_leg_3x: trend leg alone, 3x, headroom scaling, vol guard
challenge_approaches.C10_carry_leg_1x: funding-carry leg alone, 1x, headroom scaling, vol guard
challenge_approaches.C11_trend_plus_momentum: equal-risk mix of trend and momentum legs only (no carry), 2x, headroom scaling
challenge_approaches.C12_blend_3x_daily_stop: blend 3x, but after a day losing more than 1.5% of the account the next 2 days run at 0.5x (cool-down)
challenge_approaches.C13_blend_3x_profit_lock: blend 3x; once equity is +6%, the max-loss floor is treated as +2% for headroom scaling (lock in)
challenge_approaches.C14_btc_gamble: no-edge reference: long BTC 2x, headroom scaling, vol guard
challenge_approaches.C15_btc_trend: BTC-only trend (sign of 20-day return), 3x, headroom scaling, vol guard

funded_approaches.F2_cppi: blend, scale = 2 x (equity - floor) / annual vol, cap 1.5
funded_approaches.F3_equity_curve: blend 0.75x while its 20-day return is positive, else 0.25x, headroom scaling

choice_rule: an approach pair WORKS if, on both samples, funded 12-month survival >= 0.7 and 12-month net value (payout - expected fees per funded account) > 0. Report every working pair; the recommended pair per firm is the one with the lowest worst-case (over samples) expected days to a funded account, ties by net value.
